method.distance: equal-weight mixed Gower on two questionnaire indicators

decision.status: No sufficiently robust qualification-utilisation segmentation found

limitations: These are exploratory qualification-utilisation response profiles, not a validated human-capital scale.
Do not know for education usefulness is treated as unknown rather than assigned an invented rank.
Receiving training records access, not its quality, intensity, or effectiveness; training details are descriptors.
The three-input trial was rejected because it exactly reproduced training receipt; omitting training gave ARI 0.014.
The two-indicator qualification-utilisation trial is also rejected because no k=2 to k=4 candidate met the minimum-size rule across both algorithms and source-algorithm agreement was weak.
PAC is reported comparatively across k=2 to k=4; no universal absolute PAC pass/fail cutoff is imposed.
The one routing-corrupted final-Branch-F record is excluded from this employment analysis.
